apps.name: BYD Sea Lion 06
apps.localizedDescription: Компаньйон для BYD Sea Lion 06: стан авто, клімат, сидіння, камери.

versions.localizedDescription:
### Added
- **BYD cloud login over your own WireGuard tunnel while parked** («Фонова робота → Тримати хмару BYD на стоянці»). The
  head unit brings the tunnel up only while parked on a Wi-Fi network from the list you enter, switches the cellular radio
  off for the login, and restores it at ignition on or when the Wi-Fi is lost. The tunnel fields and the list stay on the
  head unit. The state (`cloud_vpn_state`, `cloud_vpn_error`, `cloud_vpn_radio_off`) goes to MQTT and four Home Assistant
  sensors; the companion app shows it read-only. Another VPN app taking the slot shows «Інший VPN-застосунок забрав тунель».
  Car checks are still open (`openspec/changes/byd-cloud-vpn/`).
